RCE Compile Normal-Form & Cache Audit — Up to 448.5x best-case warm-cache rebuild cut · 20.07x (Zen 5) & 15.44x (Core i9) prelude compile cut (Linux RAPL reported_j)

Pre-compiling librce_rt.rlib cuts cold rustc -O3 compile energy 20.07x on AMD Zen 5 and 15.44x on idle Intel Core i9; warm De Bruijn cache hits cut single-file rebuilds up to 448.5x.

• Provenance: Signed Provenance · Self-Checked (not externally peer-reviewed; studio voice is_aigc=true)
• Telemetry: reported_j (Linux powercap RAPL core/PP0 & package counters on AMD Zen 5 (20.07x prelude cut) and idle Intel Core i9-13900H (15.44x); measured_j = null.)
• Essay: https://blog.openie.dev/posts/rce-compile/
